detailedDescription: Cannot determine the frame size or a corrupted frame was received.
errorMessage: Unable to connect to indexer. This is typically caused by DNS/SSL issues. Check DNS settings, ensure IPv6 is working or disabled, consider using different DNS servers, or try a VPN/proxy if needed. See: 'https://wiki.servarr.com/prowlarr/troubleshooting#dns-ssl-connection-issues' The SSL connection could not be established, see inner exception.
